title: Normalization of a chosen strict reduction tensor comparison
statement: For every coefficient reduction record R and every isomorphism μ:R.integralClosed.tensor⋙R.reduction ≅ (R.reduction.prod R.reduction)⋙R.systemClosed.tensor supplied by the strict pullback construction, the record obtained by replacing reductionTensor by μ satisfies CoefficientReductionTensorNormalization. This is the representative square for arbitrary simultaneous flat-term K-flat pairs.

proof.text: On each simultaneous flat-term K-flat pair, compare the strict chain tensor map with the three reduction presentations and descend the resulting square to the prescribed tensor models.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientStrictReductionTensorNormalization_of
    (R : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E W)
    (μ : R.integralClosed.tensor ⋙ R.reduction ≅
      R.reduction.prod R.reduction ⋙ R.systemClosed.tensor) :
    CoefficientReductionTensorNormalization l E W { R with reductionTensor := μ }
